judge.rule: never an extractor; rules 1-5; runs 1-2 sent output_config.effort = low with no thinking block through the direct API; through the gateway's chat-completions route the native effort parameter cannot be sent, so the judge is called with reasoning = {enabled: false} (no extended thinking, as in runs 1-2) and the native effort at its default; reasoning tokens are recorded per call (plan section 12, freeze entry d)

gateway.provider_pin: provider = {order: [endpoint.tag], allow_fallbacks: false} on every call; the response's top-level `provider` (hosting provider name) is recorded on every record; a record whose provider differs from endpoint.provider_name is logged as a failed repeat and never re-sampled
gateway.usage: OpenRouter returns usage.cost (USD charged), prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens and completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens on every response; spend for the gateway arms is the reported cost; the pinned-price figure is recorded beside it

sampling: provider defaults for every extractor (no temperature, top_p, effort or reasoning parameter set unless the pilot gate lever 1 is applied and logged); response_format json_object on every arm as on the OpenAI-compatible arms of runs 1-2; fresh context per call; one shared 19-field system prompt; Anthropic 5-minute prompt cache on the three Claude models via cache_control on the system text part (OpenRouter forwards it to the anthropic endpoint)
budget_rule: hard stop USD 50; the pilot gate may raise it to 60 (plan section 9, lever 2) before dropping any arm. OpenRouter credit balance at freeze: USD 50.00 total, 0 used (key limit 100): the balance, not the stop, is the ceiling this session can spend; under lever 2 the run keeps every arm and, if credits run out, stops checkpointed for the founder to top up and resume
